title: Explosion Release
body:
Explosion Release forms from Earth + Lightning. Choose a second nature at level 25 after revealing your first at level 10; Dust Release additionally requires a third nature revealed at level 100. Clan Kekkei Genkai holders cannot gain an elemental release.

Techniques:
Level 25: Blast Clay Shot (help blast clay shot)
Level 45: Detonation Field (help detonation field)
Level 70: Blast Cascade (help blast cascade)
